transcript.content: Is shipping free? What's the minimum order for free delivery?

At Acme Outdoors, shipping is free on orders above ₹1,000 (one thousand rupees). For orders below ₹1,000, delivery charges apply. This policy is standard for all orders placed on our website.  

For more details, you can check our help center: [Shipping & Delivery Policy](https://acmeoutdoors.in/help-center/shipping-delivery).  

Would you like to know about any other policy, like returns or refunds?
